```{python}
#| label: setup
# Run python/01_clean.py to python/04_figure.py first. This report only reads their outputs.
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import Markdown

# Quarto runs this report from the reports/ folder, so the project root is one level up
ROOT = Path.cwd().parent

cleaning_log = pd.read_csv(ROOT / "output" / "cleaning_log.csv")
population = pd.read_csv(ROOT / "output" / "analysis_population.csv")
model = pd.read_csv(ROOT / "output" / "primary_model.csv")
table1 = pd.read_csv(ROOT / "output" / "table1.csv").fillna("")

arm_effect = model[model["term"] == "armIntensive"].iloc[0]
n_analyzed = population["analyzed"].sum()
```

## Summary

```{python}
#| label: summary
Markdown(
    f"In {n_analyzed} patients with baseline and 12-month systolic BP, the adjusted mean "
    f"difference in 12-month SBP change (Intensive − Standard) was "
    f"**{arm_effect['estimate']:.1f} mmHg** (95% CI {arm_effect['conf.low']:.1f} to "
    f"{arm_effect['conf.high']:.1f}), adjusted for baseline SBP and site."
)
```

## Data cleaning

The raw file was not changed. The cleaning script (`python/01_clean.py`) made these changes:

```{python}
#| label: cleaning-log
cleaning_log.style.hide(axis="index")
```

## Analysis population

```{python}
#| label: population
population.style.hide(axis="index").format({"mean_change": "{:.1f}"})
```

## Table 1. Baseline characteristics

```{python}
#| label: table1
n_by_arm = dict(zip(population["arm"], population["randomized"]))
table1 = table1.rename(columns={
    "Overall": f"Overall (N = {sum(n_by_arm.values())})",
    "Intensive": f"Intensive (N = {n_by_arm['Intensive']})",
    "Standard": f"Standard (N = {n_by_arm['Standard']})",
})
table1.style.hide(axis="index").set_caption("Mean (SD) or n (%).")
```

## Primary analysis

ANCOVA: `sbp_change ~ arm + sbp_v0 + site`, with Standard as the reference arm.

```{python}
#| label: model
model.style.hide(axis="index").format(
    {"estimate": "{:.2f}", "conf.low": "{:.2f}", "conf.high": "{:.2f}", "p.value": "{:.2g}"}
)
```

## Systolic BP over time

![Mean systolic BP (95% CI) by visit and arm](../output/fig_sbp_by_visit.png)

## Limitations

- Complete-case analysis. Loss to follow-up was higher in older patients, so the planned sensitivity analyses (multiple imputation and a mixed model using all visits) should be run.
- Sex codes `1` and `2` were recoded as M and F. This needs confirmation from the data manager.
- `cuff_size` is not in the data dictionary and was not used.
